question: Which deities are enumerated as components in this stage of the mantra teaching?
premises: Maheśa, Brahma, and Haṃsa are listed.
Bhuvaneśvarī is named in the same enumeration.
inference: This stage of the formula includes these five named deities.
plain_english: Maheśa, Brahma, Haṃsa, Indra, and Bhuvaneśvarī are named.
